terminals.name: server
terminals.description: PunchClock monitoring server (Javalin). Dashboard at http://localhost:3000 (login password: secret). Heartbeat API bearer token: punchclock-dev-secret.
terminals.command: export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; HEARTBEAT_SECRET=punchclock-dev-secret ADMIN_PASSWORD=secret java -jar server/target/punchclock-server.jar
